```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_n": (18.0, 6.0, 20.0),          # CS nfet gm/Id (higher -> lower intrinsic gain)
    "L_n": (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),             # CS nfet length (min for lowest cdd/gm)
    "gmid_p": (16.0, 6.0, 16.0),          # PMOS load gm/Id (higher -> more gds per current)
    "L_p": (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),             # PMOS load length
    "I_br": (2.0e-3, 1.0e-3, 2.3e-3),     # main branch current; 1.98 V * I_br must stay under 5 mW
}

VDD_MIN, VDD_MAX = 1.62, 1.98


def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 20e-6)        # testbench reference current into ibias
    cl = spec["cl"]
    vds_n = 1.0                           # nfet sizing point (Vout ~ 1.1 V)
    vds_p = 0.7                           # pfet sizing point (Vsd at Vout ~ 1.1 V)

    # Reference: diode nfet on ibias, nfet copy into pb, pfet diode at pb
    mr = lut.size("n", 10.0, 0.5, iref, vds=vds_n)
    mpd = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], iref, vds=vds_p)
    # Main load: pfet mirror device (same gm/Id and L as mpd -> ratio = I_br/iref)
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], p["I_br"], vds=vds_p)
    # Common-source nfet, no tail
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], p["I_br"], vds=vds_n)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)   # diode-connected, sinks IREF
    n.dev("MN2", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)       # copy: sinks iref from pb
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)         # pfet diode sources iref into pb
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)         # PMOS current source, I_br
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", m1)        # CS amplifier

    # Nominal-corner analytic predictions
    ctot = cl + m1.cdd + m2.cdd
    gds_o = m1.gds + m2.gds
    rout = 1.0 / gds_o
    gain_nom = m1.gm / gds_o
    f3db_nom = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rout * ctot)
    gbw_nom = m1.gm / (2 * PI * ctot)

    # Corner sweep at fixed bias: worst-case gain, f3dB and GBW
    worst_gain = db(gain_nom)
    worst_f3 = f3db_nom
    worst_gbw = gbw_nom
    for c in ["tt", "ff", "ss", "sf", "fs"]:
        for t in [-40, 27, 125]:
            lc = lut.at(c, t)
            a = lc.op("n", m1.W, m1.L, m1.vgs, vds_n)
            b = lc.op("p", m2.W, m2.L, m2.vgs, vds_p)
            go = a["gds"] + b["gds"]
            worst_gain = min(worst_gain, db(a["gm"] / go))
            worst_f3 = min(worst_f3, go / (2 * PI * ctot))
            worst_gbw = min(worst_gbw, a["gm"] / (2 * PI * ctot))

    power_mw = VDD_MAX * (p["I_br"] + 2 * iref) * 1e3
    swing_pred = (VDD_MIN - m2.vdsat) - m1.vdsat

    return n, {
        "gain_db": worst_gain,
        "f3db": worst_f3 / 1e6,           # MHz
        "gbw": worst_gbw / 1e6,           # MHz
        "power": power_mw,                # mW, at 1.98 V, includes both reference legs
        "vout_dc": vds_n,                 # V, sizing point (~Vout)
        "swing": swing_pred,              # V
    }
```
